# sendgrid_footer_mail_settings (Resource)

Manages the account-wide footer mail setting, which appends custom content to the bottom of every email. This is a singleton: SendGrid has exactly one footer configuration per account (or per subuser, via the provider's `on_behalf_of`); creating this resource updates that configuration in place, and destroying it only removes it from Terraform state without resetting SendGrid's setting.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendgrid_footer_mail_settings" "this" {
  enabled       = true
  html_content  = "<p>Sent with SendGrid</p>"
  plain_content = "Sent with SendGrid"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the footer mail setting is enabled.

### Optional

- `html_content` (String) The custom HTML content appended to the bottom of HTML emails.
- `plain_content` (String) The plain text content appended to the bottom of plain-text emails.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `footer_mail_settings`.
